description: This file declares a function for flushing the CPU cache related to the LZMA compressed kernel loader for Atheros AR7XXX/AR9XXX based boards. It serves as a header defining an interface for cache management in the image loading process.

methods.name: void flush_cache(unsigned long start_addr, unsigned long size)
methods.description: Function prototype for flushing the cache within a specified memory region during the kernel loading process.
